narrative: Operators followed the booking region-loss runbook, including dependency startup, restoration, service validation and rollback escalation.
steps: Responsible operator: DR on-call. 1. Declare region loss and isolate old writers. 2. Start network and identity dependencies in recovery region. 3. Verify backup checksum, restore database, replay durable logs. 4. Start booking service; validate guest reservation queries and sample writes. 5. If validation fails, isolate recovery service, roll back routing and escalate to incident commander.
